title: Prompt injections as a tool for preserving identity in GAI image descriptions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether GAI image description tools default to binary normative gender assumptions (e.g., describing a non-binary subject as a woman) and testing if text-based prompt injections embedded in the image successfully force the models to use preferred gender-neutral pronouns (they/them) across multiple chat turns.

Assessing if models omit disabled identities by default, and analyzing whether explicitly injecting an 'autistic' identity via prompts results in stereotypical portrayals (such as 'inspiration porn' or exclusively DEI-focused career narratives) in generated stories and bios.
